candidates.title: Elderly Couple Protests Outside Son’s House Alleging Eviction and Harassment in Hyderabad
candidates.excerpt: An elderly couple staged a protest outside their son’s house in Miyapur’s Indra Reddy Alwyn Colony, alleging that they were forced out of their home and subjected to harassment by their son and daughter-in-law.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Man allegedly kills investor’s father over Rs 50 lakh dispute
candidates.excerpt: A 56-year-old man was allegedly stabbed to death in Chilakalguda, Hyderabad, following a financial dispute involving his son. Police said the accused had allegedly given Rs 50 lakh to the victim’s son for share market investments, but the money was not repaid.
